evals.name: rawaq-ramadan
evals.prompt: The Rawaq Ramadan brief is in brief.md (in the working directory). Find us references for the creative kickoff next week and give us creative territories.
evals.expected_output: 20-30 real, live references across direct/category/adjacent/wildcard rings (≥5 GCC, Ramadan-relevant, coffee and beyond), top teardowns, patterns and white space, 3-5 territories with Arabic names grounded in ≥2 references each and respecting the avoid-list, a visual board/deck with images.
